summary: Prime Medicine filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a primary follow-on offering of 35,714,286 common shares at $3.50, raising $125.0M gross ($117.5M net before expenses), a discount to the $4.30 close on November 9, 2026. Underwriters Jefferies, TD Cowen and Goldman Sachs hold a 30-day option on 5,357,142 additional shares. Delivery is expected on or about November 12, 2026. This is a routine equity shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and aftermarket pressure from the greenshoe overhang.
